name: tgpt 2.16.0
body:
## Changelog

### New AI Providers
- **API Route (`apiroute`)**: Added OpenAI-compatible gateway support with tool calling (default model `gpt-5.5`; supports `API_ROUTE_API_KEY`, `API_ROUTE_MODEL`, `API_ROUTE_URL`, `API_ROUTE_BASE_URL`).
- **DemonRoute (`demonroute`)**: Added OpenAI-compatible provider (`https://api.demonroute.com/v1`) with tool calling.
- **Runcrate (`runcrate`)**: Added OpenAI-compatible provider (`https://api.runcrate.ai/v1`) with tool calling (default model `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`; supports `RUNCRATE_API_KEY`, `RUNCRATE_MODEL`, `RUNCRATE_URL`, `RUNCRATE_BASE_URL`).
- **Obscurify.ai (`obscurifyai`)**: Added OpenAI-compatible provider (`https://obscurify.ai/v1`) with tool calling (default model `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`; supports `OBSCURIFY_API_KEY`, `OBSCURIFY_MODEL`, `OBSCURIFY_URL`, `OBSCURIFY_BASE_URL`).

### New Web Search Providers & Built-in Tools
Added opt-in choices for `--search-provider` / `SEARCH_PROVIDER` and corresponding built-in tools (documented in `SEARCH_SETUP.md`):
- **Keenable (`keenable` / `web_search_keenable`)**: Works without an API key.
- **Sofya (`sofya` / `web_search_sofya`)**: Uses `SOFYA_API_KEY`.
- **Parallel (`parallel` / `web_search_parallel`)**: Works without an API key via anonymous Search MCP, with idle connection cleanup forwarding.
- **SpecStream (`specstream` / `web_search_specstream`)**: Uses `SPECSTREAM_API_KEY`.

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- **OpenCode provider**: Fixed it.
- **Gemini provider**: Replaced the shut-down `gemini-2.0-flash` default model with `gemini-3.6-flash`.
- **DeepSeek Web provider**: Fixed output truncation at both the beginning (handling `SET` events on `fragments` and response paths) and end of streams (increased `bufio.Scanner` buffer limit to 1 MiB in `src/helper/helper.go`).
- **SSE stream parsing**: Stopped dropping chunks whose generated text contains `"data: "` across `deepseek`, `gemini`, `groq`, `minimax`, `openai`, `opencode`, `pollinations`, and `koboldai` (and prevented panics on `"data:"` without a space in `koboldai`).
- **Sampling parameters (`--temperature`, `--top_p`)**: Restored forwarding of `--temperature`, `--top_p`, `TGPT_TEMPERATURE`, and `TGPT_TOP_P` across OpenAI-compatible providers, `obscurifyai`, `pollinations`, `ollamacloud`, and `koboldai`.
- **MiniMax provider**: Included `tools` in chat completion requests.
- **CLI `--tools` / `-t` flag parsing**: Normalized `-t <tool_list>` / `--tools <tool_list>` arguments so subsequent flags (e.g., `-t web_search_exa -i`) continue to parse properly.
- **Windows `glob` tool**: Switched matching from `filepath.Match` to `path.Match` so `*` and `?` do not match across `/` directory boundaries on Windows.
- **Piped stdin & error output**: Preserved newlines between piped stdin lines (up to 1 MiB per line) and wrote non-interactive HTTP error bodies to `stderr` instead of `stdout`.
